checks: prepared terminal discarded on failed write
CAS conflict publishes no partial terminal
successful atomic CAS contains one annual/cohort/terminal
lost response and stale peer redelivery both deduplicate
new IDs rejected after freeze; no memorial writes

chromiumMatrix.fullStateHashPerCodec: initial read and actual navigation restart

limits: Manual export remains v1 uncompressed JSON.
No iPhone/Safari or natural thirty-year run.
Synchronous full-world validation/parse/clone remains tens of seconds; no claim of smooth mobile performance.

Normal/Hard Node process maxRSS increased while Easy decreased; sampled browser process-tree RSS includes shared pages and verification probes. Easy gzip RSS additionally includes large fault/reload probes.
storage.estimate is engine-specific estimated usage, not an exact physical file size.
No production deduplication/prefix pools, removed facts or rebuilt gameplay fields.
No full-history long-running phone memory/leak claim.
